title: Audit each post processor against the public manuals of its control

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
This issue tracks one audit for each post in `assets/posts/`. An audit compares what the post writes with the control maker's own public manuals. A real defect gets its own issue. This issue only keeps the status.

How an audit runs:
- An agent reads a copy of the post from `main` and names the commit in its report.
- It searches a local, private library of the makers' manuals. The manuals stay local; reports cite the manual name and page and describe the rule in our own words.
- A second agent checks each finding against current `main` and the existing issues before anything is filed.
- Clean-room limits apply: no CAM vendor posts or output are used.

Status (2026-11-26):

| Post(s) | Manuals available | Audit | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `haas.cps` | Haas NGC mill/lathe manuals 2016-2025, workbooks | done, triaged | 15 findings. 2 were fixed before (#3681, #3694). 8 are in #1977, #1978, #1979, #1984, #1986. 2 are not reachable. No new issue. |
| `linuxcnc.cps` | LinuxCNC manuals | done (`a1c57b475`), triaged | 11 findings. New: #4147 (P3, also `tormach.cps`), #4151 (P6), #4152 (P7). 1 duplicate (#3198). 4 not reachable. |
| `mach3.cps`, `mach4.cps` | Mach3 / Mach4 manuals | done (`0604494bc`), triaged | 15 findings. New: #4141 (P3), #4142 (P3), #4148 (P7), #4149 (P6). 2 duplicates (#3530, #2886). 3 not reachable. 4 wording or deliberate refusals. |
| `sinumerik.cps`, `sinumerik-810m.cps` | SINUMERIK manuals (840D sl, 828D) | done (`bd467a0cc`), triaged | 17 findings. New: #4143, #4144, #4145, #4146 (P3), #4150 (P7). 2 duplicates (#4102, #2886). 2 already decided (#2349, #2357). 3 wrong. 2 not reachable. |
| `tormach.cps`, `tormach-lathe.cps`, `tormach-plasma.cps` | Tormach / PathPilot manuals | to run again (the first run stopped on a tool permission) | - |
| `heidenhain.cps`, `heidenhain-klartext.cps` | Heidenhain TNC manuals | not started | - |
| `sodick-wire.cps` | Sodick LN manual | not started | - |
| `fanuc.cps`, `fanuc-lathe.cps`, `doosan-dnm.cps` | none: the FANUC and DN Solutions portals need a login | blocked | - |
| `mazak.cps` | none: Mazak needs a registration | blocked | - |
| `grbl.cps`, `grblhal.cps`, `carvera.cps`, `richauto.cps`, `agie-native.cps` | download in progress | waits for manuals | - |
| `tinyg.cps`, `g-edm.cps`, `wire-iso.cps`, `sinker-iso.cps`, `waterjet-iso.cps` | generic dialects: no one maker manual | not planned | - |

Done means:
- Each post with public manuals has an audit on a named commit.
- Each real finding has an issue (new, or a comment on an existing one), and the row links it.
- The blocked rows say what is needed (for example, a copy from a machine owner).
